## Summary

**Stage 3 lowers the model surface; the profile owns every difference.**
`lower_profile` (`hh-compiler/src/lower.rs`) produces the canonical
`ModelSurface{layout, tools, interaction_mode, params,
transcript_renderer, dialects}` — every compiled element stamps the
`ProfileRule` ids that shaped it and the profile's evidence ref, so the
`surface ↔ HIR` identity map is total and attributable. The two
ADR-0020 minimal profiles ship (`minimal_profiles`): `minimal-patch`
(prefix naming, `patch` variant — a patch-text arg `parse(grammar_ref)`'d
into `edits`) vs `minimal-string-replace` (suffix naming,
`old_string`/`new_string` projecting into `edits[0]`). Their surface
diff is exactly the owned-field union (`surface_diff` emits
`owned_fields`-convention paths; `ac_cp_02_*` proves ⊆). `tool_shape`
rule params are the CF-199 map `{capability → SurfaceFamilyRef}` — the
flat spelling is not a param shape and link fails closed on a missing
`family_id`.

**Stage 4 lowers to targets with declared loss.** `hh-mcp-target/1`
carries each tool with the minimum carried set in
`_meta["dev.cognition/hir"]` (`semantic_id`, `surface_id`, `effects`,
`permission_class`, `budget_ref`, `provenance`) — `bundle_id` is
deliberately absent so bundle identity stays a pure function of outputs;
the hint projection lands in `annotations`. `hh-provider-request/1` is
the `ProviderRequestPlan` — schemas narrowed to
`PROVIDER_STRICT_KEYWORDS`, out-of-subset keywords are `narrowed` loss
entries under `prefer` and `UnexpressibleSurface` under `require`
(`schema_dialect.strict`). Every dropped element is a typed `LossEntry`
(`no_slot | hint_only | untyped_slot | narrowed | truncated`); MCP's
granularity ceiling is `component`, provider's `configuration`.
`lift(mcp)` → `PartialHIR{recovered, unknown, declared_unverified}`
round-trips the carried set (T-LCD-11's `lift∘lower ∪ loss = x` holds
per capability); `lift(provider_tool_api)` is a typed refusal (ADR-0021
D5) and the T1–T7 `name_to_semantic_id` normalisation record rides the
artefact as data (ADR-0118 D6).

**Equivalence is executable, and failure refuses the surface.** E4 runs
the declared `tests.e4_suites[]` differentially over the closed `fs_map`
world — reference arm vs surface arm, end-state *and* effect records
compared; the transform interpreter is pure (`identity | rename |
const | project | parse`) and typed-refuses `coerce`/`unescape`/
`resolve_name`; grammars are suite data (`hh-line-patch/1` line
blocks). Open-world capabilities report `n/a{open-world}`; the named
closed-world primitives (`edit_file`/`execute`/`read_file`) require
`pass` — a missing suite fails (§3.2.6 rule i). E5 checks declared
`error_classes` against `ErrorFormatSpec` surjectivity +
distinguishability; E6 checks `truncate` renderers retain validator-read
fields. A `fail` verdict is `UnexpressibleSurface` — never a warning.

**`relower` re-runs stages 3–5 and refuses to move the plan.** The new
bundle mints a fresh `bundle_id`; a `RuntimePlan` difference is a typed
refusal (profile-independent semantics cannot move under relowering).
`TranscriptMigration{old/new bundle + profile refs, dropped_items,
rewritten_items, reason}` plus `relowered_event` produce the
`model.surface.relowered` record the runtime ticket emits (AC-CP-09's
compiler half). The retire arm compiles (`profile − tool_shape`).

**`compose` merges by declared policy, never generic deep-merge.**
`hh-assembly/src/compose.rs` applies layers in ascending precedence
through `MERGE_POLICIES`: `stricter-wins` on `/slots/*/enabled` (a
disablement from any layer wins), monotone `authority_cap` (a lower
layer may only narrow — widening is `C-COMP-1 AuthorityViolation`
naming the capping layer), equal-precedence disagreement on a
`replace` path is `C-COMP-2 LayerConflict`. Every composed constraint
stamps its authoring layer's provenance and the document carries
`layers[]`.

**`space`/`enumerate` validate before any budget is spent.** The full
ADR-0025 override grammar parses (`=`, `+`, `++`, `~`, `=v1,v2` choice
sweep, `class_id=variant_id` group retarget — which unpins the slot's
version, clears the stale `resolved` member, and syncs the
`native.slots` mirror). Every candidate validates before acceptance;
rejected points carry the full `ValidationReport`; `search_budget`/
`eval_budget` are declared-empty placeholders (AC-CC-08). Stage 6a
(`C-PROF-1`) checks a pinned `profile_binding`'s capability
declarations against the named profile (unbound ⇒ vacuous; 6b stays
`n/a{not_run}` — C1). The bundle carries `opacity_report` — the 7-O
value verbatim from the single producer `hh_hir::ops::opacity`
(CF-050; AC-CP-12 compares them equal).

## Tests

- `crates/hh-compiler/tests/s3_2.rs` — 15 tests: T-LCD-04 matrix,
  AC-CP-02 diff, T-LCD-11 lift round-trips (MCP) + typed provider
  refusal + narrowed-loss typing, T-LCD-03 reference harness +
  opacity, AC-CP-12 bundle opacity, `ablate` (clean + `UnresolvedRef`
  refusal), `relower` (new bundle id, plan unchanged, migration record,
  retire arm, byte-determinism), E4 pass/no-suite-fail/divergence,
  E5 surjectivity, loss-report granularity ceiling.
- `crates/hh-assembly/tests/s3_2.rs` — 11 tests: override grammar
  parse, compose precedence/`authority_cap`/equal-precedence conflict/
  disablement, group overrides, `enumerate` budget placeholders +
  rejection path, stage 6a compatible/incompatible/unbound.
